final_message:
All 13 tests pass.


Implemented both functions:

**`slugify`** (`slugs/text.py`): Translates special letters (ß→ss, etc.), NFKD-decomposes accents and strips combining marks, lowercases, drops apostrophes, collapses non-`[a-z0-9]` runs to `-`, strips leading/trailing `-`, then trims to `max_length` at word boundaries (or mid-word for the first word). Falls back to `"untitled"`.

**`unique_slug`** (`slugs/unique.py`): Calls `slugify`, and if the result is in `taken`, appends `-2`, `-3`, … until one is free. Cuts the base slug to fit the suffix within `max_length`, stripping any trailing hyphen from the cut.

--- a/slugs/text.py
+++ b/slugs/text.py
@@ -1,6 +1,47 @@
 """Turning titles into slugs."""
+
+import re
+import unicodedata
+
+_SPECIALS = {
+    ord("ß"): "ss",
+    ord("ẞ"): "ss",
+    ord("æ"): "ae",
+    ord("Æ"): "ae",
+    ord("œ"): "oe",
+    ord("Œ"): "oe",
+    ord("ø"): "o",
+    ord("Ø"): "o",
+    ord("ł"): "l",
+    ord("Ł"): "l",
+    ord("đ"): "d",
+    ord("Đ"): "d",
+}
 
 
 def slugify(text: str, max_length: int = 60) -> str:
-    """Return the URL slug of `text`. See README.md for the rules."""
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    if max_length < 1:
+        raise ValueError("max_length must be at least 1")
+
+    text = text.translate(_SPECIALS)
+    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
+    text = "".join(c for c in text if unicodedata.category(c) != "Mn")
+    text = text.lower()
+    text = text.replace("'", "").replace("’", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)
+    text = text.strip("-")
+
+    if len(text) > max_length:
+        candidate = text[:max_length]
+        if text[max_length] != "-":
+            last_hyphen = candidate.rfind("-")
+            if last_hyphen > 0:
+                candidate = candidate[:last_hyphen]
+        text = candidate.rstrip("-")
+
+    if not text:
+        text = "untitled"
+        if max_length < len(text):
+            text = text[:max_length]
+
+    return text
